title: schweinfurthia pedicellata

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Schweinfurthia pedicellata include alkaloids and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits, including its ability to boost the immune system and protect against infections.
